name: @akter/python-client
description: Generates a Python client from a served OpenAPI document: typed models, one method per public member, and a runtime that keeps one command id across retries.

scripts.test: bun --bun ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --root ../.. packages/python-client/src && python3 -m unittest discover -s python -p 'test_*.py'
